content:
The Circularity in Construction project is based on the “Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry” protocol, a collaboration protocol promoted by the Ministry of the Environment and Climate Action, between BUILT CoLAB and the Environmental Fund, with the participation of APA, CIP, CPCI, AICCOPN, AECOPS, PTPC and IMPIC. BUILT CoLAB has put in place a series of initiatives initiatives, including the implementation of various training actions and thematic thematic workshops, the dynamization of sectoral working groups and the production of diagnostic reports, which gave rise to the Action Plan for Circularity in Construction. The aim is to promote a future with more circular construction, innovation in circular construction and better application of the waste management regulatory framework.

Main Actions

  • PACCO - Plano de Ação para a Circularidade na Construção
  • Relatório do Estado da Arte em Portugal
  • Workshops e Ações de Capacitação
  • Guia de Gestão de Resíduos de Construção e Demolição

Complete information at https://circularidade.builtcolab.pt/ .
